# Know what can be cleaned up before you delete it.

> Paste a branch snapshot and see which stale Git branches are delete candidates and which still hold unique work. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded and nothing is deleted.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/repository-branch-hygiene/)
- [Is it safe to delete this Git branch?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/repository-branch-hygiene/is-it-safe-to-delete-this-branch.html)
- [This tool vs. the GitHub Branches page](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/repository-branch-hygiene/vs-github-branches.html)
